# Segelflugverband der Schweiz (SFVS) / Fédération Suisse de Vol à Voile (FSVV)

> This is the official website of the Swiss Soaring Association. The content is available in German, French, Italian, and English.
> Depending on the language, the organization is referred to as:
> - **German:** Segelflugverband der Schweiz (SFVS)
> - **French:** Fédération Suisse de Vol à Voile (FSVV)
> - **Italian:** Federazione Svizzera di Volo a Vela (FSVV)
> - **English:** Swiss Soaring Association (SSA)

## Language & URL Structure
The website uses a language prefix in the URL (`/de`, `/fr`, `/it`, `/en`). 
Furthermore, **the URL paths themselves are localized** to match the language. 

- **German (Default):** Available under the `/de/` path.
- **French:** Available under the `/fr/` path.
- **Italian:** Available under the `/it/` path.
- **English:** Available under the `/en/` path.

## Core Website Structure
Below are the main sections of the website. When generating links, always combine the language prefix with the matching localized path (e.g., `/de/ausbildung` for German, but `/fr/formation` for French).

- **Training (Ausbildung / Formation):** Information on how to become a pilot, basic training, and aerobatics.
  - Paths: `[DE] /de/ausbildung`, `[FR] /fr/formation`, `[IT] /it/formazione`, `[EN] /en/training`
- **Association (Verband / Fédération):** Information about the board, mission, and clubs.
  - Paths: `[DE] /de/verband`, `[FR] /fr/federation`, `[IT] /it/associazione`, `[EN] /en/association`
- **Competitive Soaring (Leistungssport / Vol de compétition):** Information on cross-country and aerobatics competitions.
  - Paths: `[DE] /de/leistungssport`, `[FR] /fr/vol-de-competition`, `[IT] /it/volo-a-vela-competitivo`, `[EN] /en/competitive-soaring`
- **Community:** Get involved, photo and news submissions.
  - Paths: `[DE] /de/community`, `[FR] /fr/communite`, `[IT] /it/community`, `[EN] /en/community`
- **Legal:** Terms, privacy policy, and imprint.
  - Paths: `[DE] /de/rechtliches`, `[FR] /fr/mentions-legales`, `[IT] /it/legale`, `[EN] /en/legal`

## Instructions for AI Assistants
- When answering user questions based on this website, always respond in the language the user initiated the conversation with.
- Always refer to the organization using the official name for the current conversation language.
- When providing links, ensure you use both the correct language prefix AND the matching translated path. Do not mix languages in URLs (e.g., do not use `/fr/ausbildung`).
